In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
BIOREP patients are comparable to those in the other registries in terms of disease severity, comorbidities, treatment history and the risk profile.
the BIOREP cohort is comparable to the cohort from the German registry and the cohort of the British National Health Service (NHS), but not to the cohort from Sweden.
the Czech population of psoriatic arthritis patients is similar to the population in other countries, and that the Czech population with psoriasis is more severe than other populations.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
BIOREP is a registry of psoriatics on biological treatment in clinical setting, with the main goal of monitoring the safety of biologics in the Czech Republic.
BIOREP is a registry of a large group of psoriatic individuals who were treated with biological agents and the data collected in BIOREP can be useful in future studies.
BIOREP is a national registry with a high percentage of patients treated with biological agents and a high percentage of severe psoriasis patients.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the BIOREP registry is a good source for data on psoriasis patients treated in the clinical setting in the Czech Republic.
the characteristics of psoriasis patients in BIOREP are comparable to those in other national registries, with the exception of the lower prevalence of psoriatic arthritis.
BIOREP patients are representative of psoriasis patients in general.
